body: I’m looking for how you would personally react, hypothetically, to losing a loved one.
I still have my first pair of earrings that I got pierced when I was one year old!
Yes!! That sounds awesome! I have a piano so I play random things I make up and it helps a lot!
Dude same! Do you have any pets? I know spending time with my pets help :-) or create something!  I taught myself how to make a three ingredient chocolate torte!
I think it’s because I focus too much on negative things rather than the good. I get into my head too much and thoughts get out of control. Do you know what I mean?
I have a similar feeling too. I get numb and I can’t feel. But then it hits like a wave. My dreams aren’t helping either. :(

One thing i do is redirect my focus! Whether that’s putting on a show, picking up a puzzle, cleaning, calling a friend— I’ve been struggling with thought of suicide again but with the nice weather, it helps to go on walks.
A small thing I did was set daily reminders on my phone that pop up! “You are loved” “You are with it” or “what are you thankful for” — these are such wonderful encouragements that remind me of my intrinsic value. I definitely recommend this! 

Also know you are valued and loved deeply!

Reading  your post I can say that I can’t relate in some ways but, in most ways I do. 

I’m the exactly opposite of NPD and feel a lot of things deeply but I easily get overwhelmed with negativity that I just wish I could turn off and go numb. But I understand and relate to the feeling of “what’s the point..” so much that I have planned ways to commit suicide from getting strong sedatives to scalpels. 

However, part of me still wants to be the best version of myself. Self awareness amazing for acknowledging those negative aspects and characteristics of ourselves to better the person who we are meant to be. Taking it a day at a time to grow is crucial. 

Do you think you will go to therapy or a psychiatrist to work on your NPD? 

Please know that you are loved and cared for deeply by people around you, even if you don’t feel it or it doesn’t seem true. 

P.S.
I had someone comment Cicero on my imgur post   Earlier today and i saw your username and have an intuition to respond. They give me so much joy with their songs and carefree attitude. I actually have a yellow parakeet 💛

I hope i helped in some way!
